stem.text: Which statement about nitrogen or its compounds is correct?

A.text: In the Haber process the temperature is kept high to give a good equilibrium yield of ammonia.

B.text: Nitrogen gas is unreactive because of the strong nitrogen-nitrogen double bond.

C.text: Nitrogen monoxide will react with carbon monoxide under suitable conditions.

D.text: The formula of ammonium sulfate is $\text{NH}_4\text{SO}_4$.
